title.en: 文理生生 on the spine: the course named 文, and how a law is read from it
title.zh: 文理生生在脊柱上：以文名一历逐步之值，与律何以自文读出

statement.en: 文 names a run's states read through a map step by step (Parting.course), 文同 two states whose courses agree (Law.SameFuture); the epistemology of 文 (laws read off the unfolding, 读书百遍其义自见, 理 and the 文) is tied to checked laws, each with its scope; 文理生生 is compared character by character.
statement.zh: 以文名一历之状经一象逐步之值，文同即二状之文逐步皆同（Law.SameFuture）；文之认识论（律读自展开、读书百遍其义自见、理与文）逐环对到已检之律，各写其域；文理生生逐字对照名表。

hypotheses.en: No Lean and no premise is added: each claim is tied to audited declarations as they stand, with their hypotheses (a bound, a family holding every state, decidable values) stated where they apply. The name, the division of 文 from 历 and the readings are the AI's (D63); 文理生生 is evidence of a separate reading, partly independent (the same corpus, both AI-written).
hypotheses.zh: 不新增 Lean，不加前提：每一主张对到现有已审计之声明，其若（有界、一族尽其状、值之同异定然否）在所用之处写明。名、文与历之分、诸读法是 AI 的（D63）；文理生生是另一阅读之证据，独立只是部分的（同一语料，都由 AI 写成）。

does_not_show.en: That any actual book or reader meets the conditions of the laws: the correspondence is not a theorem, and agreement is not confirmation.
does_not_show.zh: 任一实际之书或读者满足诸律之条件：对应不是定理，相合不是印证。

does_not_show.en: That 文理生生 or classical Chinese is the best expression of the core: untested; the reading test designed here (after 文理生生's H2) compares only the codes it runs, and is not run.
does_not_show.zh: 文理生生或古汉语是核心最好之表达：未经检验；本章所设计之阅读试验（依文理生生之 H2）只比较所运行之码，且未运行。

does_not_show.en: That the coarsest value-keeping law-carrying class merges exactly the states with the same 文 as one theorem: it follows from four checked laws together.
does_not_show.zh: 守值载法之最粗之类恰并文同之状为一条定理：它由四条已检之律合起来得出。

validation_scope.en: verify_zh.py passes: 1342 quotations in their frozen texts, 5479 citations of Lean names (each in receipt 20261022T070506.681048Z or a listed periphery declaration), 709 record links, the name table (449 names) and the generated tables of the three chapters; import_wenli.py --check binds 98 files. The central section was checked against each cited Lean statement; the chapter, the changed 條 and the landing texts were reviewed in four rounds (the landing texts in the last three) by independent lenses, a skeptic checking each finding. All readers AI.
validation_scope.zh: verify_zh.py 通过：1342 句引文在其冻结原文中，5479 处所引之 Lean 名皆为回执 20261022T070506.681048Z 中之名或所列外围之声明，709 个记录链接，名表（449 个名）与三章之生成表；import_wenli.py --check 绑定 98 个文件。中心一节逐条对照所引 Lean 声明检查；本章、所改之條与落地之文经四轮独立视角审读（落地之文在后三轮），每一发现各有一个质疑者。读者都是 AI。

next_delta.en: The H2 reading test and the fidelity count (experiments/wenli-reading-transfer); in Lean, the coarsest value-keeping law-carrying class as one theorem and the laws of 文 joined to Web.AlikeThroughUpTo and CrossSituational, each claimed on the board first; 文理生生's G1 as a query layer of the spine.
next_delta.zh: H2 阅读试验与忠实之测（experiments/wenli-reading-transfer）；Lean 中：守值载法之最粗之类作一条定理，文之律接到 Web.AlikeThroughUpTo 与 CrossSituational，各先在看板认领；文理生生之 G1 作脊柱之查询层。

correspondence.en: Ren, 22 October 2026: “是的，让它成为整合的中心，至于文，文也不是很确定怎样给它“立名”最好，请找到最恰当的方式” (provenance, not warrant). The chapter names 文, ties the epistemology of 文 to the laws, and compares 文理生生 with the 中华本. Reading (the AI's, D63): the line of 文 in the classical texts and characters is a fitting expression of the core's language and epistemology, each link with a corresponding checked law and its scope; whether it is closer than other expressions is untested.
correspondence.zh: Ren，2026年10月22日：“是的，让它成为整合的中心，至于文，文也不是很确定怎样给它“立名”最好，请找到最恰当的方式”（来历，不是根据）。本章为文立名，把文之认识论对到诸律，并以文理生生对照中华本。读法（AI 的，D63）：古书与汉字中之一线是核心之语言与认识论之一种贴切之表达，每一环有已检之律相对，各写其域；它是否比其他表达更贴近，未经检验。

detail.en: The 中华本 and its name table, to which 文 and 文同 are added.
detail.zh: 中华本与其名表，文与文同加入其中。

detail.en: Learnable.learnable_iff gives 其义: in a world a list holds, with values through the map decidably equal or not, a state value is learnable exactly when any two states with the same 文 have state values agreeing from some step on along their orbits; its reading form, Learnable.learnable_iff_reading, is held by what-an-extrapolation-given-nothing-fixes (related).
detail.zh: Learnable.learnable_iff 给出「其义」：一族尽其状、像之同异定然否时，状值可知，恰当凡文同之二状，沿二者之轨，其状值自某步起逐步相同；其读之形 Learnable.learnable_iff_reading 在 what-an-extrapolation-given-nothing-fixes（见相关）。

detail.en: A bound makes a finite prefix fix the course, with the exact length.
detail.zh: 有界则有穷之往定文，其长确切。

detail.en: Parting.course, the course of a run.
alike_moments_iff and coarsest_iff: states read off a course; the coarsest value-keeping class merges exactly the states with the same course, one law (WL2).
detail.zh: alike_moments_iff 与 coarsest_iff：自文读状；守值之最粗之类恰并文同之状，一条律（WL2）。

detail.en: Compression and generalization by one class.
Learning by elimination and no prefix fixing the next value.
detail.zh: 过则改，与往不定其次值。

detail.en: learnable_iff_reading, reading_predicts and given_nothing_not_every: a state value learnable exactly when eventually a reading of the course, prediction given that reading, and no extrapolation given nothing learning every learnable value.
detail.zh: learnable_iff_reading、reading_predicts 与 given_nothing_not_every：状值可知恰当它自某步起是文之一读；给其读则自见；什么都不给，就不能于每一种可知的状值皆得。

detail.en: The RO map, whose kinds and layers are used.
detail.zh: RO 之对应，用其关系与层。

detail.en: WL2: 识 reads the prefix of its own course where what couples in is read as values.
detail.zh: WL2：感读作值时，识所读者是其自身之文之往。

progress.en: The name 文, the epistemology of 文 on the laws, and the comparison with 文理生生.
progress.zh: 文之立名，文之认识论在诸律上，与文理生生之对照。

progress.en: WL2: the open Lean items proved (the coarsest value-keeping class as one law, a formation's own course, the course of names read back).
progress.zh: WL2：所列 Lean 项已证（守值之最粗之类作一条律，待者自身之文，名之文之读回）。
